0x38b8688 822 821 Specifies shadows for boxes, or inset shadows/glows.  The shadow shape will match the border box for the panel,so use border-radius to affect rounding.  Syntax takes optional shape 'inset', 'fill', or 'hollow', then color, horizontal offset pixels, vertical offset pixels, blur radius pixels, and spread distance in pixels. Inset means the shadow is an inner shadow/glow, fill is a a shadow behind the entire box, hollow means clipping it to outside the border area only (before offset).
